slot_note: Assigned ground (quantitative-finance / market-microstructure-execution-cost) cannot host anomaly-detection: no quantitative-finance task type serves it, and the coordinator confirmed the assignment was drawn off a coverage grid without the objective map. The finance group's only AD task type (banking-credit-financial-risk / fraud-aml-detection) was registered by task196 while this draw was being written. Taken from the coordinator's fallback list because the architecture's confound (a reserve unit's own market-block ramp moving its output in the same seconds its frequency response is measured) is native to a power system and to no other ground on that list.
niche: the frequency containment reserve portfolio of an independent flexibility aggregator: which contracted site's primary response is genuinely short of its contracted droop rather than measured short because its own market-block ramp moved its output in the same seconds
stakeholder_role: the reserve portfolio desk of an independent flexibility aggregator

spine.entity: one one-second record of one contracted site's active power inside one boundary window
spine.grain: site x boundary window x second

world.org_type: independent flexibility aggregator running a portfolio of grid-scale batteries and gas-engine sites into the system operator's frequency containment reserve market

layer1: interval labels and the DST change inside the window (CEST to CET), telemetry in UTC against schedules in local market time; two telemetry archives with different sign conventions for charging; site and unit ids across the asset register, the schedule file and the operator's performance report; preliminary against amended operator performance reports; kW against MW in one feed; a shortened boundary on the day the market ran a 23-hour clock change session; quality codes on estimated telemetry seconds
driver: The decisive quantity is a unit's own response to a shared signal, measured over seconds in which the unit's output is also moving along a scheduled trajectory that the records give only as its endpoints, and because the shared signal deviates systematically at exactly the moments those trajectories run, taking the output change over the episode, or its change from the scheduled endpoint, measures response plus trajectory and ranks the units by the direction their trajectories happened to run rather than by the response they owed.
driver_concrete: Each contracted site's delivered droop response has to be measured against its own market-block ramp trajectory, recovered from the boundaries where no qualifying deviation occurred, because deterministic frequency deviations fall at the same quarter-hour boundaries at which every site is ramping to a new schedule, so a response taken as output minus the pre-event level, or minus the block setpoint, credits the sites that happened to be ramping up and penalises the sites that happened to be ramping down.
stump: The default path measures each site's response as its output change from the second before each qualifying deviation (or from the block's scheduled setpoint), divides by the deviation to get MW per hertz, compares that with the contracted droop and files the site whose qualifying deviations mostly fell on boundaries where it was ramping down, while the site whose droop is genuinely about three-quarters of contract sits mid-table because its deviations fell on boundaries where it was ramping up.
analyst_test: A strong analyst joins the telemetry to the schedules, fixes the DST boundary, the sign convention and the kW feed, reads the technical conditions' definition of delivered response, subtracts the block setpoint (or the pre-deviation second) from the measured output, divides by the deviation and ranks the sites on realised droop against contract, and files the site that was ramping down through its deviations, because the schedule file gives only block endpoints and nothing in it names the ramp trajectory that was running through those same seconds.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is a unit's realised droop (megawatts of primary frequency response per hertz of deviation, outside the deadband), which power systems measure against the unit's own scheduled trajectory because deterministic frequency deviations coincide with market-block ramping, and a noun swap breaks the task because outside a synchronous power system there is no droop, no deadband and no shared deviation that every unit answers to in the same second.

differentiation.task155: task155 forecasts a forward take-up rate for open tasks whose chance of being taken depends on adjacency to already-scheduled work; this build measures a physical response slope (megawatts per hertz) confounded within each episode by a scheduled trajectory running in the same seconds, with no take-up probability and no forward rate.
differentiation.task467: task467 separates a temporary from a permanent change across a treated and a comparison series whose component mixes differ; this build has no comparison series and no series decomposition, and recovers the confounding trajectory from the same unit's own boundaries where no qualifying deviation occurred.

notes: stump_strategy causal_design: the decisive move identifies a unit's own response against a confounder that runs in the same seconds and is correlated with the shared signal by market design, which is the estimand_identification family's confounding case; gate_g decomposition_attribution because the mechanism splits one observed output movement between two causes where their coincidence decides the split. forum and org_family are 'other': no vocabulary key names an asset-light flexibility aggregator (utility_or_infrastructure is both inaccurate and banned against the last three), and no committee or board decides, the determination being signed inside the performance desk and filed with the system operator.
